description: Search ONE collection – a host's portfolio, a residential community or a destination – named by its slug (posadita.com/s/{slug}, or from /llms.txt). There is no search across all of Posadita. With dates and guests every place is priced for exactly that stay (totalCents, the same figure get_quote gives) and those that can be booked come first; without dates you get each place's from-price per night. Only places with bookable:true can be quoted or checked out; the others are booked by contacting their host.

amenities.description: Every one of these, not any.

availableOnly.description: With dates: leave out places that cannot be booked for them.
